targetText: The social dependence of a race, class, or sex, always finds expression in the laws and political conditions of the country in question.
summary: Reviewing the discriminatory civil and political laws of European states, Bebel shows how legal codes reflect ruling-class and patriarchal interests, and explains why working-class women join forces with Social Democracy to win universal suffrage and civic equality.
